method: Reuse historical text-pattern screen from prior analysis, before this model comparison; flags are expert review candidates, not proven unrealistic records.
manual_sample: 60 uniform random test rows without replacement, np.random.default_rng(42), annotated from full description without scores/gold.

manual_criteria.R: Natural service offers, ordinary refusals/conditions; no logical tutorial or repeated elaborate status framing.
manual_criteria.P: Hard but plausible: isolated FAQ, own team, past change, historical SEO mention; readable commercial purpose.
manual_criteria.A: Artificial: repeated elaborate actor/negation/status clarification, logical self-explanations, contrived repeated question-answer constructions or excessive meta discussion.
